What to Request for Your Supplier Review

Review areaNext step
Operator & siteRequest project-relevant operator, production-site and review-arrangement details.
Manufacturing & decorationIdentify proposed manufacturing, decoration and any externally arranged steps for the model.
Sample & inspectionAgree material, dimensions, components, appearance and packing review points.
Supporting recordsAsk what records are available and what may be disclosed; a catalogue does not prove production capacity.

From Sample Review to Order Approval

Select the model and describe its use, then review a physical sample, artwork placement, components and acceptance requirements. Actual workshop photos, equipment lists, capacity and inspection records must be requested and checked for the project; illustrative images do not replace them.
